skill.name: pdf-page-extract
skill.description: Extract PDF page data, rendered page images, embedded images, and page mappings for AI-assisted document conversion workflows.
skill.summary: Prepare PDF pages as traceable extraction artifacts for downstream AI document generation.
skill.author: AbeJitsu

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally instructs agents to run local Python extraction commands and inline Python rendering code. Most static hits are markdown paths, artifact names, or safe relative project paths, and no prompt-injection, network, credential access, or malicious intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: The skill relies on external Python scripts and inline Python execution.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for user confirmation before running commands, show the exact command first, and require the referenced scripts to be present in a trusted project path.

remediation.issue: Examples use ../ paths after changing into Calypso/tools.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve all paths to an approved project directory before writing outputs, and avoid accepting untrusted output paths without confirmation.

remediation.issue: The skill assumes specific local filenames and directories.
remediation.suggestion: Document that users should adapt paths to their own project and avoid processing sensitive PDFs unless local artifact storage is acceptable.

content.user_title: Extract PDF Pages for AI Workflows
content.value_statement: PDF conversion projects need reliable page text, images, and layout references before AI generation can begin. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through deterministic extraction steps that create reusable artifacts.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of PDF page mappings from footer information.
Extracts text spans with font, position, color, and style metadata.
Renders high resolution PNG page images for visual reference.
Extracts embedded page images and related metadata when available.
Defines validation checks for JSON artifacts, PNG files, and page completeness.
Creates persistent extraction artifacts for downstream HTML or document generation.
limitations: Requires local Python tools such as PyMuPDF and pdfplumber to be available.
Uses project-specific Calypso paths that users may need to adapt.
Does not perform OCR for image-only pages by itself.
Can create local files and images, so users should confirm output paths first.

use_cases.title: Prepare pages for HTML generation
use_cases.description: Create text, image, and layout artifacts before generating HTML from a PDF chapter.

use_cases.title: Audit extracted PDF content
use_cases.description: Persist page metadata and rendered images so reviewers can compare extraction output against the original PDF.

use_cases.title: Build repeatable document pipelines
use_cases.description: Use deterministic extraction outputs as stable inputs for later AI-assisted processing steps.

prompt_templates.title: Extract one PDF page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single page artifact set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the pdf-page-extract skill to extract page 15 from my PDF. Show me the commands before running them and save the artifacts locally.

prompt_templates.title: Extract a chapter range
prompt_templates.scenario: Process multiple pages with page mapping and validation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract chapter 2 pages 15 through 28. Create the page mapping, rich extraction JSON, rendered PNG files, and embedded image metadata.

prompt_templates.title: Validate existing artifacts
prompt_templates.scenario: Check outputs after extraction has already run.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the extracted PDF artifacts for chapter 2. Confirm the JSON parses, PNG files are readable, and every page in the range has text spans.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare data for downstream generation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow handoff to another document generation step.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the extraction workflow for the selected pages, then summarize the artifact paths and any pages that need OCR or manual review before HTML generation.

output_examples.input: Extract page 17 from chapter 2 for downstream HTML generation.
output_examples.output: The skill prepares a page mapping, a rich extraction file with text span metadata, a rendered PNG image, and image metadata if embedded images exist.

output_examples.input: Validate the extraction for pages 15 through 28.
output: Reports whether JSON files parse successfully.
Confirms rendered PNG files exist and are readable.
Lists pages with missing text spans or incomplete metadata.

output_examples.input: Create reusable artifacts for a PDF conversion pipeline.
output_examples.output: The skill produces persistent local artifacts that later skills can use for layout analysis, HTML generation, and traceable review.

best_practices: Confirm all commands and output paths before running local extraction tools.
Keep extracted artifacts in a dedicated project directory for traceability.
Validate JSON, page coverage, and PNG readability before downstream AI generation.
anti_patterns: Do not run the commands against sensitive PDFs without confirming local storage requirements.
Do not assume the default Calypso paths match every project.
Do not continue to downstream generation when extraction outputs are missing or invalid.

faq.question: Does this skill modify my PDF?
faq.answer: No. It reads the PDF and writes separate JSON, PNG, and image artifacts.

faq.question: Can it handle scanned pages?
faq.answer: It can render scanned pages as images, but it does not perform OCR by itself.

faq.question: Which tools does it expect?
faq.answer: It expects local Python extraction tools and libraries such as PyMuPDF and pdfplumber.

faq.question: Why does it create page mapping?
faq.answer: Page mapping connects PDF indices to book page numbers so later steps use the correct pages.

faq.question: Is it safe to run automatically?
faq.answer: It runs local commands and writes files, so users should review commands and paths before execution.

faq.question: Can Claude Code use the outputs?
faq.answer: Yes. Claude Code can use the saved artifacts as inputs for validation, layout review, and later generation tasks.
